chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from a number of our companions, from 'Ali ibn Asbat, from Abi al-Harith, who said:
I asked al-Rida عليه السلام: May a man perform salat (prayer) in a garment of silk? He said: No.

key_terms.الرَّجُلُ: the man; the male subject of the ruling
key_terms.ثَوْبِ: a garment or piece of clothing
key_terms.لَا: a negative reply indicating prohibition or non-permission in this context

ai.seo_question: Can a man perform salat (prayer) while wearing a silk garment according to Imam al-Rida عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a legal ruling from Imam al-Rida عليه السلام regarding salat (prayer) in a garment made of silk. The Imam عليه السلام answers in the negative, indicating the impermissibility or disapproval discussed in the chapter concerning prayer in pure silk.
